Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Wanderley Oliveira was born on 29 March 1988 based on the Wikipedia page of a Brazilian boxer. However, the task required identifying the correct individuals among multiple candidates with the same name. The Planner failed to recognize that the Wanderley Oliveira mentioned in the Wikipedia source competed in the 1988 Summer Olympics, which would make it impossible for him to have been born in 1988. This oversight led to an incorrect conclusion that Alexey Volkonsky was born first.
